content.comment_body: Hello, I am considering whether it is possible to customize the web server or develop a new one entirely. This would allow for I/O control through a portal when connected to a Wi-Fi router. The built-in web server is adequate for monitoring, but I prefer a simplified portal displaying only I/O control buttons upon login. I am familiar with various web technologies, so designing the interface is straightforward. My main concern is integrating this with [product_name] [version_no]. Thanks!

For [product_name] in the [version_no] 8.0 (FS01-FS03) and 8.1 (FS04-FS06) series, modifying the default web server is not supported. The related article numbers end with [article_no] (x = 0 or 1). Only the newer [product_name] of the 8.2 series allow you to create custom web server pages. For these models, the article numbers conclude with [article_no].
Understood! I should have been more careful when purchasing my current two devices. Looks like it’s time for an upgrade. Thanks [user_name], your assistance has really helped today!

A new question posted by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread titled 'Want to establish an internet connection on the web server [product_name] [version_no] using a ddns address.' Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are looking for more flexibility in customizing integrated web servers for [product_name] devices, aiming to create streamlined interfaces for I/O control. However, only certain hardware versions accommodate these customizations, which causes disappointment among advanced users when they realize their current device lacks the required functionality. This leads to regret over purchase decisions and unmet technical expectations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to customize or replace the integrated web server, enabling the creation of a simplified, button-oriented portal for I/O control that leverages their web development capabilities.
